approved_scopes: Orthogonal-projection robust noncentrality reduction is exact, with allowed attaining perturbations in the full whitened Euclidean ball.
Gaussian identity-covariance coordinate-statistic noncentral chi-square law and differing-df calibration caveat are correct.
Independent enumeration confirms 34 feasible panels, unique cost13 AE optimum and unique gain-per-cost greedy path D,F,C of cost16.
The unlisted shift2e_D is exactly invisible to AE, including repeated observations, while full data retain the stated center and worst-case noncentralities.
Analytic optimality proof, nonredundancy witnesses and inclusion-minimality assertions are sound.

optional_improvements.description: The extension formula using (BΣBᵀ)⁻¹ implicitly needs B to have full row rank when Σ is positive definite. The finite coordinate instance already satisfies this, so the theorem/example is unaffected.
optional_improvements.fix: State full-row-rank B, or use the Moore–Penrose inverse when redundant linear channels are permitted.
